---
name: git-helper
description: Guide git operations including conventional commit message generation and diff inspection.
---

Inspect the current git status and changes:

1. Check changed files (`git status -s` and `git diff`).
2. Propose conventional commit messages using:
   - `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `test:`, or `chore:`
3. Provide a clear imperative summary line (under 50 characters) and explanatory bullet points.
